packingBehavior.description: When filling a requested area with rooms from a named size band, prefer the largest valid rectangular or square room interiors that fit the band and available space. Do not create smaller fragmented rooms or extra all-wall padding when a larger valid room can fill the space cleanly.

shapeTrimBehavior.description: The final external map shape does not need to remain a perfect rectangle or square. If satisfying a requested map size creates excess rows or columns that cause double walls, trim or omit those excess tiles instead of preserving the rectangle. For example, a requested 10x10 map may become 9x10, 10x9, or otherwise non-rectangular if trimming prevents doubled walls and keeps floors enclosed.

sharedWallBehavior.description: When two rooms touch, their bordering wall lines must collapse into one shared wall line. Do not create two adjacent parallel wall rows or columns between touching rooms.

outerWallBehavior.description: A room or packed room group must not create an extra parallel outer wall row or column next to an existing wall boundary. This applies to north, south, east, and west boundaries. A south or east room edge should reuse the same single wall line when adjacent to another boundary instead of adding a second wall line.

enclosureBehavior.description: All generated floor tiles must be enclosed by the final outer wall boundary. The exterior edge of the generated room group should be wall or door tiles, not floor tiles. Internal shared wall seams must remain continuous except where intentionally replaced by a single collapsed door tile.

collapsedBoundaryFloorBehavior.description: When wall rows or columns collapse during room packing, any affected floor rows or columns must remain inside the final room or packed room group. Do not leave a free row or column of floor tiles outside the final outer wall boundary.

sharedDoorBehavior.description: When doors from adjacent rooms would occupy neighboring or overlapping positions on a shared wall, collapse them into one shared door tile in the single shared wall line.

description: Rooms are rectangular or square areas with floor interiors and wall perimeters. Room size measurements are based on interior floor tiles only. Walls add one tile around the floor area. When filling space, prefer the largest valid room interiors in the requested size band before creating smaller rooms. Adjacent rooms may share a single wall tile line instead of creating double walls. The final exterior shape may be trimmed or non-rectangular if preserving the requested rectangular size would create double walls. Outer boundaries may not become double walls or exterior floor rows. Collapsed floor rows or columns must remain inside the final outer walls, never outside them. Internal wall seams should remain continuous except for intentional single-door openings. If two door locations would be adjacent or overlapping on a shared wall, they should merge into one door tile. Every room must have at least one door.
